app_context.name: Barbearia do Carille
app_context.aesthetic: Moderno premium: preto, branco e vermelho (Luxury & High-Contrast Swiss-Editorial)
app_context.target_audience: Modern men seeking premium grooming experience with fast online booking and professional barbers
app_context.primary_goal: Enable quick client appointment scheduling, service selection, barber selection, time slot picking, and instant visual confirmation with a management area for services/barbers/appointments.

rules.h1_size: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-black
rules.h2_size: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight uppercase font-bold

colors.guidelines: Use Deep Obsidian #0A0A0A as anchor. Pure white for text contrast, and Electric/Styptic Red (#DC2626) exclusively for key CTAs and active states.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: animated red glowing gradient border on hero cards and selected active states
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay and clean geometric grid lines

public_page.hero_section: Immersive luxury barber interior background with high-contrast typography, live badge, and instant 'Agendar Horário' CTA
public_page.services_section: Editorial pricing & service cards with duration, price, and instant select action
public_page.barbers_section: Professional barber cards with specialization, rating, and direct booking trigger
public_page.booking_modal_or_section: Interactive 3-step booking flow (1. Select Service, 2. Select Barber & Date/Time, 3. Client Name & Phone with instant screen confirmation)

admin_management_area.dashboard_tabs: Manage Services (add/edit/delete), Manage Barbers (add/edit/delete), Manage Appointments (view list, update status, cancel)

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Never use full transparent background for navigation or floating dialogs without backdrop blur.
Maintain strict dark luxury aesthetic with #DC2626 red accents and pure white typography.
Implement fully working editable demo data for services, barbers, and appointments stored in localStorage with React state.
Include both public booking client view and admin management dashboard.
